title: Credit Card Validator
description: Check locally whether a card number has a plausible format and valid Luhn check digit without sending or saving the number.
metaDescription: Check locally whether a card number has a plausible format and valid Luhn check digit without sending or saving the number.

form.title: Validate card number
form.description: Type or paste a number to check generic format and the check digit with the Luhn algorithm.

input.title: Card number
input.label: Number or PAN
input.privacy: Validation runs in your browser. This tool does not put the number in the URL or send it to the server. Prefer test numbers while learning and avoid real cards on shared devices.
input.hint: Use only the card number. Do not enter CVV, expiration date, name, tax ID, or address.

mask.label: Show masked result
mask.hint: The shared link and copied summary always use the masked number, even if you turn this off.

share.title: Share
share.description: The link preserves only the masking preference, never the typed number.
share.safe: Sharing does not include number, hash, CVV, expiration, cardholder, bank, or network.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result shows format and Luhn only, not existence, balance, authorization, or acceptance.
result.emptyDescription: Enter a number to start the local check.
result.validDescription: The check digit matches the Luhn algorithm.
result.invalidChecksumDescription: The check digit does not match the Luhn algorithm.
result.incompleteDescription: Use 12 to 19 digits for this generic card-number check.
result.maskedHint: Masking is on: only trailing digits may appear.
result.unmaskedHint: Local unmasked display. Copy, link, and URL still omit the full number.
result.checkDigitUnavailable: Unavailable until the format is sufficient to run Luhn.

explanation.empty: Educational typing-check tool. It does not process payments or query issuers.
explanation.incomplete: There are not enough digits yet to run Luhn within the generic card-number range.
explanation.invalidFormat: Fix characters, length, or repeated sequences before interpreting the check digit.
explanation.invalidChecksum: The check digit does not match; there may be a typo, extra character, or incomplete number.
explanation.validChecksum: The check digit matches the Luhn algorithm. This does not confirm the card exists, is active, or can be used for a purchase.

input.label: Input
input.pass: There is no relevant leading or trailing whitespace.

characters.label: Characters
characters.pass: Only digits and accepted visual separators were used.

repeated.label: Repeated sequence
repeated.pass: The digits are not all identical.

checkDigit.label: Final digit
checkDigit.pass: The final digit matches the Luhn expectation.

luhn.label: Luhn checksum
luhn.pass: The Luhn sum closes on a multiple of 10.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.pass: The number stays in the browser.

issues.empty: There is no number to validate yet.
issues.trimmedWhitespace: Leading or trailing spaces were ignored for validation.
issues.unsupportedCharacters: Remove letters, unsupported punctuation, emoji, or non-ASCII digits.
issues.incompleteLength: Use at least 12 digits for this generic check.
issues.tooLong: Generic card numbers should not exceed 19 digits.
issues.repeatedDigits: Sequences where all digits are identical are rejected even when Luhn passes.
issues.luhnUnavailable: Luhn does not run while there is a format or length issue.
issues.invalidChecksum: The final digit does not match what the Luhn algorithm expects.
issues.validChecksum: The final digit matches what the Luhn algorithm expects.
issues.localOnly: The number stays in your browser, is not put in the URL, is not saved, and is not sent to the server.

summary.scope: Scope: local format and Luhn check; does not confirm existence, ownership, balance, authorization, or acceptance.

details.title: What this validation covers
details.description: The tool checks only local and generic typing rules without external lookups.

luhn.title: Luhn algorithm
luhn.description: Calculates the expected final digit and compares it with the last digit entered.

format.title: Generic format
format.description: Accepts ASCII digits and simple visual separators, with a 12 to 19 digit range.

noLookup.title: No issuer lookup
noLookup.description: Does not identify bank, network, country, holder, limit, balance, risk, or authorization.

privacy.title: Link privacy
privacy.description: The URL, shared link, and copied summary do not carry the full number.

checks.question: What does this validator check?
checks.answer: It checks whether the digits have a plausible length and whether the check digit matches the Luhn algorithm.

purchase.question: Can a card that passes Luhn be used for a purchase?
purchase.answer: No. Luhn only shows internal digit consistency. It does not confirm existence, active status, balance, authorization, safety, or acceptance.

privacy.question: Is the card number sent to any server?
privacy.answer: Not by this tool. Validation runs in the browser, and the URL, shared link, and copied summary do not include the full number.

sensitive.question: Why do you not ask for CVV, expiration, or name?
sensitive.answer: Those details are sensitive and unnecessary for a format and Luhn check. Do not enter those details here.

issuer.question: Does the validator identify bank, network, or cardholder?
issuer.answer: No. There is no BIN/IIN, issuer, bank, network, country, cardholder, or payment-gateway lookup.

sharing.question: Can I share the result?
sharing.answer: Yes, but the link shares only the masking preference. The copied summary shows only a masked number and checksum status.

seo.about: The card validator locally checks whether a digit sequence has plausible length and a check digit compatible with the Luhn algorithm. It does not query issuer, BIN/IIN, bank, network, cardholder, or gateway data.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to validate a card with Luhn
seo.howToUse: Type or paste only the number, review the status, and read the checklist. Use the tool as typing support: a valid Luhn result does not prove that the card exists, is active, has funds, is authorized, or will be accepted for a purchase.
